build_log_cdf_normal: build a python module that computes the log CDF of a Normal distribution using log_cdf with a torch tensor
build_log_cdf_uniform: build a python module that computes the log CDF of a Uniform distribution using log_cdf with a torch tensor
build_log_cdf_generic: build a python module that computes the log CDF of any torch Distribution using log_cdf with a torch tensor
test_log_cdf_normal: test the log_cdf function by passing a Normal distribution and verifying the log CDF output matches expected values
review_log_cdf: review the log_cdf function to understand how it handles Normal, Uniform, and generic Distribution types
